BFV + 3 data volumes + 3 shares also passed target CRIU restore failure injection, source rollback, per-resource destination cleanup, and immediate retry. The current driver requires exact profile/local Nova ownership, no privileged Incus true token in profile/local/expanded configuration, expanded migration.stateful=true, and migration.incremental.memory=false in the dedicated profile, instance-local config, and expanded config. A versioned source attestation plus locked execution-boundary revalidation fail closed before CRIU when these invariants are absent.
